## Description

Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request, the rationale behind the design, and any associated issue references (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## Type of Change

Please mark only the options that apply to this PR:

- [ ] **Bug Fix:** A non-breaking change that resolves an issue.
- [ ] **New Feature:** A non-breaking change that introduces new functionality.
- [ ] **Breaking Change:** A change that alters existing functionality and requires configuration or code updates in other components.
- [ ] **Refactoring / Chore:** Code cleanup, performance optimization, file restructuring, or maintenance task (no user-facing behavior changes).
- [ ] **Documentation:** Updates or additions to project documentation.

## How Has This Been Tested?

Describe the test coverage and validation steps carried out for this pull request.

- [ ] **Unit Tests:** Run unit test cases matching the module modifications.
- [ ] **Integration Tests:** Run tests checking cross-module interactions.
- [ ] **Manual Verification:** Direct terminal command testing, database verification, or other manual validation steps (provide details/screenshots).

## Pull Request Checklist

Please ensure all of the following requirements are met before submitting the PR for review:

- [ ] My code strictly adheres to the style guidelines of this repository.
- [ ] I have performed a detailed self-review of my own code changes.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in complex or non-obvious algorithms.
- [ ] I have made corresponding updates to the project documentation (ADRs, diagrams, API specs).
- [ ] My changes do not generate any unexpected compile-time, lint, or runtime warnings.
- [ ] I have added comprehensive test coverage that verifies the bug fix or feature.
- [ ] All new and existing tests pass locally.
- [ ] The branch is rebased onto the latest `main` branch to avoid merge conflicts.
